findings.condition: Create the new session on the account's limited environment ('Default': package registries and MCP hosts only, no variables), passing its environment_id explicitly, unless the conductor names a host it needs. A session created by another session cannot be moved later, so this is chosen at creation or not at all.

findings.finding: Detaching repositories does not take away add_repo, create_session or the scheduled-task tools; the old session used them, and the new one will have them too. The reset holds only if the new session does not attach again.
